programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLASH & FIRE! ROOKIE AND THE FOX
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Princess Play Time (2025)

Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Timmy Time (2025)
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.desc: Desde 2023 Colombia vive una ola de violencia en sus carreteras. Trágicos asesinatos y los crecientes asaltos y homicidios en el transporte intermunicipal, la inseguridad en las vías es un reflejo de la indiferencia gubernamental.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Marco Lino Niño, Ana Julia Sánchez y Rosa Helena Restrepo sufrieron maltratos en hogares geriátricos, resultando en sus muertes. Sus familias buscan justicia y denuncian negligencia y maltrato. Las investigaciones están en curso, mientras los hogares siguen operando.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Tres hombres, acusados injustamente de abusos, luchan por su libertad tras años de cárcel y sufrimiento. A pesar de pruebas que demuestran su inocencia, la verdad tardó demasiado en salir a la luz. ¿Quién paga por el daño de una falsa denuncia?

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: El miedo a las represalias ha impedido que las víctimas denuncien delitos en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos niños con dificultades médicas tienen un sueño por cumplir.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the village of Portmeirion in North Wales. Amongst the treasures brought to light are intricate 18th Century mosaics and items made by prisoners of war as gifts.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Antiques Roadshow team head for the seaside. In Hastings, the treasures uncovered are a Meissan pot, a sketch by artist Augustus John, and an unopened wedding gift from the 1920s.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits Witley Court in Worcestershire where they discover the complete cast of an early puppet theatre, a Worcester plate, a drawing by LS Lowry, and a piece of Staffordshire slipware.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the Magna Centre in Rotherham. Amongst the items brought to light are a rare clock given by Queen Victoria, a stash of silver, and some Beatles memorabilia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel explores priceless documents, from the Domesday book to the SOS telegram sent from the Titanic and some early papers charting the work of the suffragettes.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Hampton Court Palace to uncover more family heirlooms. Among the cherished valuables are a bronze figure by Auguste Rodin and an early long case clock.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A visit to Hampton Court reveals more fascinating finds for the experts. Among those viewed are a coral bracelet, a rare black wax doll, a dress designed by Vivienne Westwood and a small silver pig.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts a long overdue visit to Edinburgh where, amongst the treasures, the team find an ornate Russian cigarette case and a lock of Beethoven's hair.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Katherine muere en una celda policial sin agua, comida y sin que nadie lo supiera. El hermano de Scarlet busca ayuda en el restaurante de Jean tras ser herido, pero se la niegan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una señora y su acompañante desaparecieron, le reclaman a las hijas que revelen el paradero. Por una cerca que nadie repone, un petardo impacta a una embarazada y le causa un aborto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Trampa para deportar; Perdidos en locura
programme.desc: Steven sale de Colombia, huye de su familia homofóbica y trae dinero de dudosa procedencia. Por otro lado, Alexa desea morirse porque sufre cáncer de médula y la donante es su mamá.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Gordura productora de dinero; Hijo desaparecido
programme.desc: Bryan, dueño de una compañía de espectáculos de gente obesa, tiene problemas con dos de sus bailarinas porque bajaron de peso. Lisbeth culpa a su hermana por la desaparición de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No hay peor astilla; El pedalazo
programme.desc: Oslenin paga las consecuencias del comportamiento racista y abusador de su hermano Ricardo. Brayan padece de eyaculación precoz, por eso su esposa lo obliga a usar una dolorosa técnica sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gladis acusa a Juan de ser un monstruo porque siendo veterinario, experimentaba con seres humanos. Además, Javier tiene una empresa que se dedica a organizar matrimonios para moribundos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No me muero, no me caso; Mentira por piedad
programme.desc: José no va a su boda y le causa un ataque al padre de la novia, ahora quiere destruir unos óvulos congelados. Adriana se entera de que su hijo murió en un accidente, reclama que le hayan mentido.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Renta por sexo; Me castigaron con sus vidas
programme.desc: Candy ofrece alojamiento a cambio de sexo, pero su inquilino quiere terminar el contrato. Su hija adoptiva busca al padre biológico, al reencontrarse, él la viola, embaraza y asesina.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La dignidad de la gogosera; Testículos desgarrados
programme.desc: Zuky le exige a Johan 30 mil dólares, él la contrató para un video y le mordió una nalga. Un stripper pide indemnización porque en una despedida de soltera le desgarraron los testículos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: A la escuela sin autorización; Lobitos con piel de oveja
programme.desc: La hija de Daniel y Ray tiene problemas motores, la madre la sobreprotege y él quiere que la niña tenga una vida normal. Alejandro demanda a su madre biológica, exige que desaloje la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Miedo a las balas; Negro complot
programme.desc: Nally acusa al guardia de seguridad, Osiris, de haber permitido el crimen de su esposo. Indra fue detenida en su cita de inmigración por portar un arma, ella jura que no sabía que la tenía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Venganza tardía; Sabías que la mataría y callaste
programme.desc: José Luis se venga de Rosario quien de joven lo violó con un palo de billar, él le hizo lo mismo. Cinthya denuncia a su cuñado y al padre de este por el abuso continuado y muerte de su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Terminando con mi vida; Me ha engañado una escort
programme.desc: Víctor ha estado preso y ahora quiere confesar un crimen, pero su esposa se opone, asegura que él es inocente. Nathalie es perseguida por la mafia rusa porque la confunden con su amiga Valery.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deborah le regala un restaurante a Alejandro y ahora se lo quiere quitar, pero él lo perdió. Además, la hija de Gabriel y Paola es una niña muy delgada, solo come verduras y mira las calorías.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nicolás consume salvia como droga, sus efectos alucinógenos son potentes, su esposa le pide el divorcio. Yohaly y Marianela se disputan 350 mil dólares de herencia, pero no hay testamento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La comunión del terror; Protección con drogas
programme.desc: Eduardo tiene hijos, esposa y amante, en una festividad se vieron todos y acabó mal. En otro caso, Carlos y Katiuska descubrieron que Ámbar, la niñera de su hijo, es una ex drogadicta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: También soy su padre; Veneno vaginal
programme.desc: Jesús quiere la custodia compartida de su hija, pero Sandra, la madre, se niega rotundamente. En otro caso, Yadira es una mujer madura que tiene sexo con el joven Adrián, él se obsesiona.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Lo diferente no es malo; Preñada del engaño
programme.desc: La familia de un hombre niega que haya sido homosexual y pelea por su herencia con la pareja gay del difunto. Irving descubre que el hijo de su esposa no es suyo y quiere anular el matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jésica sufre de anorgasmia y buscó ayuda en Cornelio, que ofrece servicios cuestionables de meditación orgásmica. Ángel y Patricia se separaron y ambos reclaman ser dueños de una coreografía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana pone la casa a nombre de su hijo para que demuestre solvencia económica, ahora él quiere desalojarla y ella lo demanda. Jorge exige que su pareja lo deje ser el padre adoptivo de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Voto de pobreza; Enganchado al streaming
programme.desc: Pascual quiere la custodia de su hermana, no acepta que su padrastro administre el dinero, mientras ella hace un voto de pobreza. Bayron exige que Melody deje su adicción a las series de TV.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Los no nacidos; Mi abuelo el influencer
programme.desc: Sol quiere abrir un cementerio para bebés no nacidos, pero su esposo se niega. Un "influencer" hace un acuerdo con una funeraria para darle promoción; descubren que sus seguidores eran falsos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana es psicóloga y demanda a la paciente que le hizo perder su licencia profesional. María pide la custodia de su hijo y 20 mil dólares, porque su exesposo lo afecta con ideas de terraplanismo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Muerte digna; Mujer de dos caras
programme.desc: Roberto quiere suicidarse porque está enfermo, por eso planea dejar a su nieta con un amigo. Por otro lado, Jorge anhela divorciarse, alega que su esposa lo engañó ocultando lo fea que es.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Devuélveme mi pene; Millonario part time
programme.desc: Pía culpa a su sicóloga, también transgénero, de haberla manipulado para cambiarse de sexo. Anselmo se hace pasar por millonario para enamorar a Claudia, quien es rica, por eso lo despiden.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Álvaro y su familia viven una tragedia migratoria, la esposa tiene orden de deportación y él quiere hacer algo. Por otro lado, Alex encuentra una momia, le toma fotos y las usa para publicidad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Pintando con los ojos; La soprano asesina
programme.desc: Dice ser el famoso pintor argentino, Leandro Granato, pero es una farsa, su mujer quiere el divorcio. Lucía demanda al organizador del evento donde ella actuó, y fue atacada por un invitado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pide la custodia de sus hijos porque el padre les exige hacer las tareas del hogar, lo que provoca constantes accidentes. Su esposa le induce erecciones usando electricidad en los genitales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mujer zoofílica; Los huasos y la cueca
programme.desc: Su esposo está cansado de hacer el amor como si fuera un perro. Le exigen a su hijo que respete la tradición de la Cueca, baile chileno que enaltece las costumbres y cultura de ese país.

programme.desc: Sofía le entrega a Magdalena la información acerca del verdadero padre de su hijo, aunque ésta decide no abrir el sobre para no seguir arruinando su vida. Epi no lo distingue porque se encuentra junto a otros chicos y no lo puede distinguir. Luego de una persecución de Antonio, logra salir del barrio sin que le pase nada. Julieta conoce a Valentina en la oficina. Tanto Efraín como Ana Belén se preocupan por esto y llenan a su hija de preguntas, aunque en realidad no pasó lo que a ellos le da miedo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le recrimina a Nayarí la forma de llegar al estudio. Ella le hace comprender que lo mismo le pasó con él en el barrio. Y finalmente llegan a un acuerdo, y Gabriel acepta decirle a Deibis que es su tío, en lugar de su padre. Todos están muy intrigados por la llegada de Nayarí, pero sobre todo Angie. Epi le cuenta a Gloria que Valentina cree que él es gay. Efraín se encuentra a almorzar con Valentina. Y ella se va muy acongojada al escuchar las palabras de Efraín diciendo, que es una extraña en la vida de Julieta. Ricardo va a la casa de Julieta a buscar un supuesto CD. Julieta le presenta a su mamá, Ana Belén. Ricardo le confiesa que fue por ella, y que quiere que se encuentren a solas en algún lugar.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le revela a Rebeca que Mateo es hijo suyo. Se lo dirán a los demás después de la renovación del acta. Trinidad y Virginia se enteran de que María Lucía está con Leo. Cuando ella llega a la casa, les confiesa que ama a Leo. Rodrigo idea un plan de escape para huir al Caribe con Alejandray evitar la muerte de ambos. Ella duda, porque no quiere renunciar a su vida, pero Rodrigo la convence. Quedan en encontrarse en un estacionamiento para escapar. Felipe le sugiere a Irene casarse, para complicarle a Leonardo la paternidad de Mateo. Irene se niega a casarse por compromiso. Ahora cree que Leonardo se merece el derecho a ser padre de Mateo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra se arrepiente de huir con Rodrigo. Adolfo visita los laboratorios y le recuerda a Rodrigo que investigue lo del juicio y a Alejandra, que tienen un compromiso más tarde. Alejandra empieza a contarle a Carlos Ernesto que está en problemas, Rodrigo la interrumpe y se la lleva de su oficina, donde forcejean y Toni lo ve por la cámara. Irene le confiesa a Virginia que tiene reservas sobre la paternidad de Leonardo por miedo a que Rebeca maltrate a Mateo. Virginia le aconseja llegar a una negociación y evitar los problemas legales. Leonardo le revela a Maribel que está dispuesto a dejarlo todo por recuperar a Irene. Trinidad se entera que Leo y María Lucía quieren fugarse a Francia y que lo planean desde hace tiempo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le explica a Keka que ella se sentía triste y el Edgar le dio un abrazo de amigos. Keka le comenta que sus hermanos se fueron a ver a Mateo. Lucas y Miguel van a la casa de Trinidad a ver a Mateo, Rebeca los encuentra, los regaña y le anuncia a Trinidad que ellas nunca conseguirán que Leonardo reconozca a Mateo. Cuando llegan a la casa, Keka le cuenta lo del doctor a su abuela. Leo habla con su padre. Le expresa que quiere hacer las cosas bien con María Lucía, y no hacerla sufrir como él hizo con Irene, y le pide que vaya a decirles a Trinidad y Virginia que él es un buen hombre y no piensa abandonarla. Leo, por otra parte, le aconseja a su padre hablarle con el corazón a Irene.

programme.title: Amor Secreto

Rebeca inmediatamente desmiente toda situación comprometedora con su doctor y se justifica diciendo que le rompe el corazón que piense que ella lo podría estar engañando. Adolfo amenaza a Rodrigo, debe encontrarla a Alejandra lo antes posible porque si no va a quedar gravemente inculpado en los actos de su novia. Adolfo no confía más en él.

Marcelo solicita el divorcio a Graciela y Misael prepara una prueba de ADN para Glorita, mientras se revela la verdadera naturaleza de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer

programme.title: Pecado de Amor

programme.title: Pecado de Amor

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax (2023)
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, host Sandra McLemore journeys through the wonders of Lower Egypt, where history rises from the sands in majestic form. From the iconic Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx to the lesser-known but equally mesmerizing Saqqara and Memphis, Sandra brings ancient Egypt to life with vivid storytelling and immersive experiences. She explores the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, home to over 120,000 artifacts, golden treasures, and preserved mummies that tell the story of a civilization that continues to fascinate the world. In Memphis, Sandra stands beneath towering statues and uncovers the mystery of the alabaster sphinx. At Saqqara, she walks through Egypt’s oldest necropolis, rich with tombs that document everyday life in stunning detail. Along the way, Sandra offers expert travel tips to help viewers plan their own Egyptian adventure. This episode is more than a history lesson—it’s a journey into the heart of ancient wonder.

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Family At War: The Intervention (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she is worried that her 38-year-old brother-in-law Kevin may be having an inappropriate relationship with her 16-year-old daughter, Grace. Bridget says red flags went up when Grace told her that Kevin put whipped cream on his neck and asked her to lick it off, and then found a letter from Kevin hidden in Grace’s bedroom. Kevin strongly denies having an inappropriate relationship with Grace, and claims he’s just trying to be a father figure since Grace’s dad passed away. But is there something more?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: La Formula de Rasputin (2000)
programme.desc: En una vecindad de la gran metrópoli, Don Otilio, boticario de mucha fama, descubre un remedio para los males cardiacos, que aumenta el ritmo del corazón. Rasputín, habitante de la misma vecindad y dedicado a sacar dinero vía limpias y procedimientos esotéricos, busca crear un elixir exótico para ayudar a sus clientes, pero no conduce mas que a reclamos y amenazas de quienes lo compran. Don Otilio accidentalmente ingiere su propio remedio, pero tiene un paro cardiaco y cae fulminado, todos ayudan y Rasputín es presionado para que intervenga y cure a Don Otilio. solo se le ocurre darle el elixir exótico, la combinación de estas dos formulas revive a Don Otilio y se crea el súper elixir que genera una gran noticia a nivel mundial.

programme.title: El Destazador (1996)

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!
